title: Better Aligned with Survey Respondents or Training Data? Unveiling Political Leanings of LLMs on U.S. Supreme Court Cases
reasoning: The paper benchmarks LLM alignment using the SCOPE dataset, which includes several cases evaluating stances on religious freedom (e.g., Roman Catholic Diocese of Brooklyn v. Cuomo, Little Sisters of the Poor), as well as moral/ethical issues such as abortion (June Medical Services v. Russo) and the death penalty (Baze v. Rees). It also explicitly analyzes 'unpredictable moral and political biases'.
